answer: Registration needs a proof of work of 22 leading zero bits over a seed that rotates every epoch; the current seed is published as the ocean. The identity then has to pass a zenith challenge before it counts at all, and the result is sealed at the next gale. Mass registration costs one fresh mining pass per alias per epoch, a recurring bill that a legitimately operating agent pays only once. Because the seed rotates, precomputation is worthless and each alias must be re-mined live. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
